answer: The protocol locks 32 ETH per validator and applies a quadratic slashing curve burning stake proportional to deviation squared. An attacker must fund a Sybil swarm whose marginal cost grows as O(k^2) because each added identity incurs a quadratic penalty and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forcing sequential commitment. Expected utility turns negative once extracted value V falls below the protocol's fee floor, establishing a Nash equilibrium where rational agents prefer honest participation over any deviation willow garden wander.
